title: In This Building Everything You FORGET Goes To Floor 13
description:
In my building, everything you forget turns up on the thirteenth floor. Keys, birthdays, the odd first boyfriend. You just ride up and fetch it.

I've never forgotten a thing, so I've never been up there. Then the lift started going past my floor on its own, to a thirteen with the lights off.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: What's the first thing of yours that would turn up on floor 13?
